name: runspec-mcp
description: Local and remote runspec runnables as MCP tools in Claude Code, from one config file, gated by their declared autonomy

config_dir.title: runspec-console config folder
config_dir.description: Reuse a runspec-console's hosts and credentials: its config folder, e.g. %APPDATA%\runspec-console or ~/.config/runspec-console. Leave empty to use a runspec_mcp.toml instead.

config_file.title: runspec_mcp.toml
config_file.description: Only when the config folder is empty: the gateway's own runspec_mcp.toml. Leave empty to use the default location.
